entities.name: Angel
entities.description: Winged humanoid beings, usually manifestations of white mana and often worshiped as divine, found on many planes.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A magical salve produced by angels, originating with Capennan angels and spread by the New Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Serra
entities.description: A planeswalker who created angels on her artificial plane, Serra's Realm, and is namesake of Serra Angels.

entities.name: Serra's Realm
entities.description: Serra's artificial plane, corrupted by Phyrexian black mana and collapsing under their attacks.

entities.name: Radiant
entities.description: A Serra Angel who led a coup in Serra's Realm after Phyrexian corruption drove Serra away.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A planeswalker who evacuated some of Serra's angels to Dominaria.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Invaders whose black mana corrupted Serra's Realm and who compleated captured angels.

entities.name: Asha
entities.description: The most revered angel in Bant history, who banished Malfegor to Grixis and left a protective sigil.

entities.name: Malfegor
entities.description: A half-demon, half-dragon abomination banished by Asha to Grixis.

entities.name: Jenara
entities.description: The Asura of War, the one revealed Asura of Bant.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: An Alaran shard where mortals who conform to its ideals are reformed as angels.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The dragon planeswalker whose distorted image Amonkhet's angels reflect and whom they served during the Hour of Devastation.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: A world with male angels twisted into reflections of Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Giada
entities.description: The last free angel of Capenna.

entities.name: Capenna
entities.description: A plane whose angels cooperated with demons to build New Capenna and were later betrayed and imprisoned.

entities.name: Atraxa
entities.description: A compleated angel who saved humans from corruption before attracting Elesh Norn's retribution and leading the invasion of Capenna.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: A Praetor of New Phyrexia with a personal honor guard of compleated angels.

entities.name: Latulla
entities.description: The creator of the Copper-Leaf Angels, who fell from power.

entities.name: Sages of Lat-Nam
entities.description: The creators of the Duler angels by mutating humans.

entities.name: Trine
entities.description: The most famous fallen angel.

entities.name: Selenia
entities.description: A Serra Angel and fallen angel influential in the narrative.

entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker who created Avacyn and later killed her.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The archangel created by Sorin to keep equilibrium on Innistrad, corrupted by Emrakul into a genocidal rampage and killed by Sorin.

entities.name: Gisela
entities.description: The red-aligned leader of the Flight of Goldnight, later merged into Brisela.

entities.name: Bruna
entities.description: The blue-aligned leader of the Flight of Alabaster, later merged into Brisela.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: The green-aligned leader of the Flight of Herons, the only flight to side with humanity against Avacyn.

entities.name: Liesa
entities.description: The leader of the Flight of Dusk who allied with a demon lord and was declared a heretic.

entities.name: Brisela
entities.description: A twisted amalgamation of Bruna and Gisela that served as Emrakul's messenger and led the Flight of Nightmares.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The Eldrazi titan who corrupted Avacyn and Innistrad's angels.

entities.name: Flight of Moonsilver
entities.description: Avacyn's honor guard of angels with Helvault spears, created after her corruption.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane whose angels form flights led by Gisela, Bruna, Sigarda and Liesa.

entities.name: Razia
entities.description: The angel parun of the Boros who created all other Boros angels as copies of herself.

entities.name: Feather
entities.description: The only surviving first-generation Boros angel, who became Guildmaster after Razia's death.

entities.name: Aurelia
entities.description: A Boros angel who replaced Feather as leader and whose assaults drove angels to leave for the guildless.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose top members are angels.

entities.name: Orzhov Syndicate
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose angels are those dissatisfied with the Legion.

entities.name: Iona
entities.description: A greater archangel of Zendikar who resisted the Eldrazi's reign and kept her sight.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane whose angels wear halos over their eyes after failing to resist the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Titans and broods whose awakening defeated Zendikar's angels.

entities.name: Valkyries
entities.description: Kaldheim's angels who judge the fallen in pairs of a Shepherd and a Reaper.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion during which Capennan angels spread halo and helped repel the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Hour of Devastation
entities.description: The event when Amonkhet's angels showed loyalty to the God-Pharaoh and joined his hordes.

events.summary: A council of archmages enchants Bant so mortals who die conforming to its ideals reform as angels.
events.quote: Long ago, a council of archmages put a complex enchantment on Bant, allowing mortals who died on the shard to reform as angels.

events.summary: Asha defeats Malfegor, banishing him to Grixis, and leaves a sigil that kept Bant safe.
events.quote: she simply banished him to the Shard of Grixis

events.summary: Phyrexian black mana corrupts Serra's Realm, drives away Serra, and leads to Radiant's coup; Urza evacuates some angels to Dominaria.
events.quote: Urza was able to evacuate some of the angels to Dominaria

events.summary: Capennan angels cooperate with demons against a Phyrexian incursion and create New Capenna, but the demons then imprison the angels in stone and leech their halo.
events.quote: after its completion the demons betrayed the angels, imprisoning them in stone and leeching halo from their bodies

events.summary: After Streets of New Capenna the angels wake from stasis.
events.quote: the Angels began waking up from their stasis

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Capennan angels repel Atraxa's invasion and carry Halo to other invaded planes.
events.quote: the angels helped repel Atraxa’s invasion of Capenna

events.summary: Amonkhet's angels join the God-Pharaoh's hordes in laying waste to the plane during the Hour of Devastation.
events.quote: their true loyalty to the God-Pharaoh came to light, as they joined his hordes in laying waste to the plane

events.summary: Sorin creates the archangel Avacyn to maintain equilibrium between humans and monsters on Innistrad.
events.quote: Sorin Markov created the archangel Avacyn to maintain an equilibrium between humans and the monsters that preyed on them

events.summary: Liesa allies with a demon lord and Avacyn destroys the entire Flight of Dusk.
events.quote: earning the condemnation of her sisters and Avacyn, who declared her a heretic and destroyed the entire flight

events.summary: Corrupted by Emrakul, Avacyn goes mad and the new Flight of Moonsilver aids her genocidal rampage against humanity.
events.quote: aiding her in her genocidal rampage against humanity

events.summary: The Flights of Goldnight and Alabaster side with Avacyn against humanity, while the Flight of Herons sides with humanity.
events.quote: They were the only flight to side with humanity against Avacyn, avoiding corruption.

events.summary: Sorin kills Avacyn and Emrakul enters Innistrad, corrupting the remaining angels into the Flight of Nightmares led by Brisela.
events.quote: After Avacyn's death at the hands of her creator Sorin , Emrakul successfully entered Innistrad

events.summary: Many angels fight and die resisting Phyrexia on Mirrodin and several are captured and compleated.
events.quote: Several of these were captured and forcefully compleated .

events.summary: Atraxa saves hundreds of humans from corruption and attracts Elesh Norn's retribution.
events.quote: who had saved hundreds of humans from corruption before attracting Elesh Norn's retribution

events.summary: Aurelia replaces Feather as leader of the Boros, arguing a disgraced angel cannot command respect.
events.quote: Feather was later replaced by one of these Angels, Aurelia

events.summary: Several angels leave the Boros after Aurelia's assaults to protect the guildless.
events.quote: several angels left the Boros and dedicated themselves to the protection of the guildless

events.summary: Zendikar's angels try to resist the first stirring of the Eldrazi but are defeated and wear their halos over their eyes.
events.quote: The angels were among the first creatures that attempted to mount a resistance against the first stirring of the Eldrazi but were easily defeated.

events.summary: When the Eldrazi titans are released again, the halos of oppression shatter and the angels fight and mostly die.
events.quote: The angels fought, and mostly, they died.

relations.note: Serra created her angels to populate Serra's Realm.
relations.quote: The second type was brought into being by Serra on her artificial plane
Sorin Markov created the archangel Avacyn

relations.note: Avacyn died at her creator's hands.
relations.quote: After Avacyn's death at the hands of her creator Sorin
whose parun Razia is an angel herself

relations.note: She created all other Boros angels as copies of herself.
relations.quote: Razia created all other Boros angels as clones, reflections, or copies of herself.
who became the Guildmaster after Razia's death
Copper-Leaf Angels were artificial angels created by Latulla

relations.note: They created the Duler angels by mutating humans.
relations.quote: Duler angels were created by the Sages of Lat-Nam

relations.note: Compleated angel of New Phyrexia, titled the Praetors' Voice.
They serve as her honor guard.
